title: Story Time Practice

vocab.ex: The narrator told the story in past tense.
The plot of the story was very exciting.
The main character was a young engineer.
At the beginning, everything seemed normal.
In the middle of the story, a problem appeared.
At the end, she found a great solution.
The setting of the story was a small office.
The main event happened on a Friday.
It brought back an old memory.
It was a real adventure for the whole team.
The story had an unexpected twist.
I loved the happy ending.
The moral of the story was to never give up.
This was the hardest chapter of my career.
I still remember that scene clearly.
Once upon a time, a small company had a big idea.
Suddenly, everything changed.
Meanwhile, the client was waiting for an answer.
In the end, we solved the problem together.
That meeting was the turning point of the project.
The story had a flashback to her first job.
The episode ended with a big cliffhanger.
She was the hero of the whole project.
In this story, bad luck was the real villain.
It was a long journey to reach that goal.
The biggest challenge was the tight deadline.
The lesson learned was to plan ahead.
The ending was a big surprise for everyone.
In conclusion, the project was a success.
She is a great storyteller.

expressions.expr: Let me tell you a story about...
expressions.meaning: Deixa eu te contar uma história sobre...
expressions.example: Let me tell you a story about my first job interview.
It all started when I lost my keys on my first day.

expressions.expr: To make a long story short...
expressions.example: To make a long story short, I got the job.
And that's how it happened — I changed my whole career.

sentences: Once upon a time, there was a small startup.
It all started with a simple idea.
Meanwhile, the whole team was working hard.
The turning point came after months of effort.
In the end, the story had a happy ending.
To make a long story short, everything worked out.
The lesson learned was to trust the process.

grammar.title: Conectores para contar uma história
rules: First / Then / After that / Finally organizam a sequência da história.
Use Past Simple para a linha principal dos eventos: I woke up, I got dressed, I left.
Use Past Continuous para descrever o cenário: The sun was shining, birds were singing.
Use Past Perfect para explicar algo que aconteceu antes: I was tired because I hadn't slept well.

rows: Meanwhile, my team prepared the report.
